items.title: Signed cosine aliases on the midpoint grid

source.anchor: A3.SS3.p3/A3.Ex139; literal grid S4.E11 and standing d S4.SS1.p1.m3. Private deterministic consumer A3.SS3.p4.2,p6.1/A3.Ex144; n range S4.Thmtheorem5.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling.
source.scope: Exact all-integer grid identity. Private weighted alias-series use is a deterministic source-proof intermediate; Gaussian expectation identification and closed C8 means are not claimed.

items.statement: Every integer cosine mode on the midpoint grid vanishes except the signed aliases at multiples of twice the dimension. \sum_{i=1}^{d}\cos(k\theta_i)=\begin{cases}d(-1)^a,&k=2ad,\ a\in\mathbb Z,\\0,&k\notin2d\mathbb Z.\end{cases} Fix an integer \(d\ge2\), and set \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\) for \(i=1,\ldots,d\). The frequency \(k\) is any integer, including zero and negative integers. Lean represents the source grid by \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,d\) and \(\theta(i)=(i.\mathrm{val}+1/2)\pi/d\). In the alias case, \(a=k/(2d)\) is the exact integer quotient. Lean uses integer powers of the nonzero real number \(-1\), so negative aliases retain their parity. Away from divisibility the coefficient is literally zero. The dimension, literal grid and integer frequency are the complete public inputs. Nonzero sine denominators, divisibility arithmetic and trigonometric identities are discharged inside the proof.

obligations.label: Every nonmultiple of2d has zero grid cosine sum.
Every multiple, including zero and negative frequencies, has exact signed alias value.

bindings.boundary: The all-integer midpoint alias identity and an actual private summable weighted reciprocal-grid alias series are compiled locally. Gaussian expectation-to-grid identification, the unweighted/weighted alias-tail partitions and closed resummations, full FactC8 and Lemma4.5 variance/bias, Krylov and both full main lower bounds remain open. Exact oracle, TV precision, deterministic worst-case query caps and explicit expected-cost adapters, independent source verification, local/remote integration and purification/Exposition Seal remain separate acceptance stages.

assumption_deltas.source: Hard-family dimension d>=2, literal midpoint grid, every integer k.
assumption_deltas.lean: Exactly d:Nat,hd:2<=d,k:Int; Fin index i corresponds to source i+1.
assumption_deltas.reason: No κ, matrix, Gaussian-law, convergence or denominator premise occurs in the public alias interface.

assumption_deltas.source: The alias value is d(-1)^a when k=2ad with a an integer; otherwise zero.
assumption_deltas.lean: Integer divisibility guard, exact k/(2*d) integer quotient and integer power of real -1.
assumption_deltas.reason: The positive divisor is nonzero. Negative/zero aliases preserve parity, and the quotient outside the true branch has no effect.

assumption_deltas.source: Weighted C8 calculation uses C7, the alias at n and at integer j−n,j+n, with1<=n<d.
assumption_deltas.lean: A private actual deterministic weighted series identity and Summable conclusion use both canonical producers. Natural series mode j+1 is cast to Int before subtraction.
assumption_deltas.reason: No Gaussian expectation or closed tail sum is defined into the intermediate. Such later bridges remain open.
